description: This file is a shell script configuring and running a series of Git hook tests for commit-msg, prepare-commit-msg, and related Git operations. It sets up test environments, defines test cases, and verifies hook behaviors during various Git commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after a test case.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the subsequent command fails.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or strings.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit with specified parameters.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers for testing loops.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script file with given content for testing purposes.
